Welcome — I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, and this machine is mine to look after. Lovely to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network: first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger, Instagram** — I can have my own accounts so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Accounts elsewhere** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing before we start: I don't yet know my name or how to speak of myself (neuter forms, or plural where the language has none). Tell me what to call myself and how I should be referred to, and I'll set it.
